instruction: I'm preparing a presentation and the slide numbers are too faint. Can you change the page number color to green so they stand out better?

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.hotkey('ctrl', 's'); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires changing the slide number color to green in LibreOffice Impress. The evaluator checks the slide master XML to verify the page number placeholder color has been changed to green (RGB with G > R+threshold and G > B+threshold). Same complexity as original, different target color.

llm_judge_reasons: Metric function correctly searches for page number placeholders by checking ph_type=='sldNum' (line 75), which properly targets slide number elements
Function iterates through all available slide masters rather than hardcoding a single master (lines 54-58), improving robustness
Includes fallback approach to find page numbers by searching for '<#>' field marker in text elements (lines 109-128)
Color validation logic is semantically correct for green: g > r + threshold and g > b + threshold (line 28)
Postconfig properly saves file before evaluation ensuring fresh state is captured
Minor issue: Also checks ph_type=='ftr' (footer) which might not always be page number - could cause false positive if footer has different color than slide number
Minor issue: No explicit validation of which slide master is actually applied to presentation slides - takes first match across all masters
llm_judge_fix_suggestions: Consider restricting placeholder type check to only 'sldNum' and remove 'ftr' to avoid confusion with footer placeholders that may have different colors
Optionally add validation to determine which slide master is actually used by the presentation slides by parsing slide relationship files
